coaching.headline: Revenant and Lt. Belica scored 23 of the 24 kills without dying, and the enemy killed only Countess, twice.

flags.text: One hell of a carry: Revenant dealt 35923 hero damage, the game's most, 42 percent over norm.
The duo lane allowed zero deaths before minute ten; Steel and Drongo gave up three, including first blood.
Revenant destroyed the enemy mid outer, duo inner and duo inhibitor; Lt. Belica, the offlane outer.
Countess died to Zarus on the offlane outside any detected fight, and the enemy took Fangtooth right after.

focus.title: Cover the offlane before the first Fangtooth
focus.action: Before the first Fangtooth, ward the offlane river and contest the pit with all five alive instead of a body down.

14.1.call: Lt. Belica killed Iggy & Scorch on the mid lane and Revenant killed Steel and Drongo on the duo lane, won 3-0. Within ninety seconds the enemy duo outer tower fell and Fangtooth went to the team.

24.call: Lt. Belica killed Drongo and Revenant killed Zarus in the allied jungle, won 2-0. The enemy duo inner tower fell within the minute.

24.9.call: Revenant killed Steel on the duo lane and Drongo in the enemy base, won 2-0, and the duo inhibitor fell next.

ec0af2b1-1609-4f83-8668-4cc99d17c696: Damn clean: zero deaths against a norm near six, 8.2 CS per minute against 6.4, and the game's most gold at 15677.
Rotation kills on Iggy & Scorch at mid and Zarus on the offlane preceded the mid outer and Orb Prime. Shove the duo wave first; Drongo took the duo outer.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Most objective damage in the game at 22695, on zero deaths, but one ward placed against a norm of seven.
A hand in four of 24 team kills, while nine allied kills came on the duo lane. When Revenant and Muriel start a duo-lane fight, path there.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Third film of the last four with a death before minute ten, here to Zarus in the enemy half. Until the first Fangtooth, trade from the allied half.
Hero damage ran 248 per minute against a norm of 497, the team's lowest total. Open trades with two quick ability hits so Blood Tithe's Haemorrhage bleed starts.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zero deaths and six kills, three on Iggy & Scorch, with a 13219 to 10094 gold edge over the mid opponent.
The offlane kill on Zarus answered the Countess death within seconds. Repeat the rotation whenever the offlane loses a body before the enemy mid outer falls.
1af0cbe5-10ec-483a-8018-3ae0697338f9: Fourteen assists, the most in the game, a hand in 58 percent of team kills, and zero deaths.
Sixteen wards, the game's most, but zero enemy wards cleared while the enemy cleared six. Before every Fangtooth, sweep the pit approaches.

matchup: Duo was Revenant and Muriel against Drongo and Steel; Revenant scored seven of Drongo's nine deaths and every Steel death.
Steel built Fire Blossom and Frostguard, two physical armor items; Frostguard cuts the attack speed of heroes basic-attacking Steel.
Drongo's Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on successful basic attacks, trimming lifesteal from Terminus and Liberator.
build: Vanquisher, Terminus and Imperator are the full winning core; Tainted Rounds is the off-meta fourth.
Imperator makes critical strikes deal more damage, and the Fourth Shot of Hellfire Rounds always critically strikes.
Tainted Rounds adds a healing cut on basic attacks against Feng Mao, the game's top healer at 15885.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Sub-Surface cuts damage from area-of-effect abilities; Serration with Melting Point is the field's best Vermis pair.
Vermis ranks last among Revenant carry Eternals with enough games; Lotus leans ahead of Xyris.
augment: Hellfire Blast adds Fourth Shot damage and ignores part of bonus armor, a fit against Steel's two armor items.
Quickdraw is the field's Best Revenant carry augment, Spectral Bounty next, and Hellfire Blast, the most played, last.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and adds a shield; Liberator leans ahead of Pacifier, the most played. Sound keep.
improvement: Quickdraw for Hellfire Blast is the field-backed swap: faster reloads and higher jumps, giving up the armor ignore.
Lotus for Vermis is the field-backed Eternal change; on Vermis, Melting Point over Sub-Surface matches the best pair.
Items and crest stay; a zero-death game proves no in-match fix.

matchup: Feng Mao, the jungle opponent, went 1/0/0, the kill on Countess, and out-earned Wukong 11392 gold to 10588.
Feng Mao cleared four wards and placed zero; Wukong placed one and cleared three.
build: Manta Scythe and Infernum are two of three winning-core items; Syonic Echo is missing, The Perforator in the third slot.
Infernum ignites a target after four Kindling stacks from abilities and basic attacks, dealing max-health damage over time.
The Perforator ignores a share of physical armor, a fit against Steel's Fire Blossom and Frostguard.
eternal: Lotus grants a random stat every two minutes and on every takedown, so the four assists added stats.
Early Bloom adds an extra level at level 12; Immaculate reduces damage taken while at high health.
Lotus is in a field toss-up with Weald and Demiurge; Early Bloom with Immaculate is Lotus's best pair. Sound keep.
augment: Masterful Mimicry adds a max clone and passive Hair stacks; the field leans to Masterful Mimicry. Sound keep.
crest: Nex's Reap dashes and damages nearby heroes, boosted by Sow damage stored from hitting heroes.
Judgement is the field's Best Wukong jungle crest; Nex has too few games to lead.
improvement: Judgement for Nex is the field-backed change: area damage with healing per hero hit, giving up Reap's dash and slow.
No item change proven; the listed core with Syonic Echo wins only 41.1% in the field.

matchup: Zarus, the lane opponent, killed Countess once and died to Countess once, finishing 1/4/1.
Zarus's Tainted Blade cuts healing on physical damage, a check on Blade Siphon and Overseer healing.
Feng Mao, not Zarus, scored the second offlane kill on Countess.
build: Noxia is the only winning-core item; Orb Of Growth and Lifebinder are missing, Tainted Scepter and Overseer off-meta.
Overseer enhances Feast: 15% more damage and healing for a quarter of hero damage dealt.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage and stacks Malice for bonus ability damage on heroes.
eternal: Vesh repeats part of ability damage on heroes as damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage, Lich magical lifesteal.
Lich with Mind Rot is Vesh's best pair; Aion leans ahead of Vesh, the most played, in the Countess offlane field.
augment: Sanguine Slash adds Blade Siphon damage and healing against isolated targets.
Shadow Echo and Blood Well lead a toss-up; Sanguine Slash, the most played, trails the pair.
crest: Tempest's active damages three nearby heroes every second and heals for part of the damage.
Voidgazer is the field's Best Countess offlane crest, Tempest second; Voidgazer starts from Wizard Crest, Tempest from Warlock Crest.
improvement: Voidgazer for Tempest is the field-backed crest change: a slowing, damage-amplifying projectile instead of the heal.
Shadow Echo for Sanguine Slash holds the best augment odds; Aion for Vesh is the Eternal lean.

matchup: Iggy & Scorch dealt 18510 hero damage, second in the game, yet died six times without a kill.
Iggy & Scorch was the enemy's main magical damage, and no ally built magic resist.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings are the exact winning core.
Wraith Leggings adds bonus ability magical damage against heroes below 40% health.
Noxia marks heroes on ability damage; a separate ability on the marked hero adds max-health damage.
eternal: Aion's spells pay gold from hero damage; Bottomless Vial and Runic Focus are Aion's best pair.
Aion trails Lotus and Xyris, the leads of a toss-up in the Lt. Belica mid field.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience; the field's Best Lt. Belica mid augment. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Typhoon leans ahead of Epoch, the most played, with Soulbearer further back; Typhoon starts from Warlock Crest, Soulbearer from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Typhoon for Soulbearer is the field-backed crest change: attack speed stacks and a dash, giving up the shield.
Lotus over Aion holds the best Eternal odds; the items stay.

matchup: Duo was Muriel and Revenant against Steel and Drongo; the enemy duo died 14 times, the allied duo zero.
Steel placed 13 wards to Muriel's 16; Steel cleared one, Muriel zero.
build: Marshal is the one winning-core item; Crystal Tear and Windcaller are missing, Everbloom and Astral Catalyst off-meta.
Marshal buffs Muriel and nearby heroes with attack speed and on-hit damage, a fit beside Revenant's basic attacks.
Everbloom grants damage mitigation and tenacity to allies Muriel heals or shields.
eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field is a toss-up led by Aion and Knell, Exarch most played.
Illumination with Fervour is Exarch's best pair in the field.
augment: Sacrosanct drops a Consecrated Ground at the ally targeted by Reversal of Fortune.
Circuit Reset leans ahead of Sacrosanct: Alacrity shields cut the shielded ally's current ability cooldowns.
crest: Tranquility heals nearby heroes with brief damage mitigation and raises the ward cap to three; leads the field's toss-up. Sound keep.
improvement: Circuit Reset for Sacrosanct is the field-backed augment change, giving up the free Consecrated Ground on Reversal of Fortune.
Aion or Knell for Exarch holds better field odds; the items stay.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Muriel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
ourKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
ourKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him
